builds.title: Unbound Satarre threshold scout, Fighter 2
builds.difficulty: Tier 1 class-built NPC · no assigned CR
traits: Proficiency +2. Strength save +3 and Constitution save +5. Leather armor gives AC 11 + Dexterity modifier. The Archery fighting style adds +2 to sling attack rolls.
Keeper of Secrets grants advantage on Arcana checks about planes and planar travel. Vesk chose Insight proficiency.

Portal Sense reveals the direction and distance to the nearest nonmagical entrance or exit while Vesk is in a confined area. Vesk has advantage on Investigation or Perception checks to find hidden or invisible doors and magical portals.
Action Surge grants an extra action on Vesk’s turn once per short or long rest.
Vesk’s background grants Investigation, Stealth, Common, and cartographer’s tools.
actions: Sling. Ranged weapon attack +6, range 30/120 ft. Hit 1d4 + 2 bludgeoning.
Quarterstaff. Melee weapon attack +3, reach 5 ft. Hit 1d6 + 1 bludgeoning, or 1d8 + 1 with two hands.

Unraveling Touch. Action, once per long rest. A creature Vesk can see within 30 ft. makes a DC 13 Constitution save. On a failure it must spend its action each turn to repeat the save. A success ends the effect.
Second Wind. Bonus action once per short or long rest. Regain 1d10 + 2 HP.
builds.tactics: In a closed room, Vesk calls out the nearest ordinary exit. If someone blocks that route, he uses Unraveling Touch to buy time for others to get past.

builds.title: Serpentine Lamia river scout, Rogue 2
builds.difficulty: Tier 1 class-built NPC · no assigned CR
traits: Proficiency +2. Dexterity save +4 and Intelligence save +2. Leather armor gives AC 11 + Dexterity modifier.
Serpent Strike gives Tara advantage on attacks against a creature she has surprised or that she or an ally has charmed.
Snake Body gives advantage on checks and saves to avoid being knocked prone. Tara gains no benefit from effects or gear that require legs or feet.

Once per turn, Sneak Attack adds 1d6 to a ranged or finesse weapon hit when Tara has advantage or another enemy of the target is within 5 ft. of it and isn’t incapacitated. Disadvantage blocks the extra damage unless it is canceled.
Expertise in Deception and Stealth. Proficient with thieves’ tools. Tara’s background grants Sleight of Hand, Survival, navigator’s tools, and water vehicles.
actions: Shortsword. Melee weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft. Hit 1d6 + 2 piercing.
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit 1d4 + 2 piercing.
Cunning Action. Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a bonus action.
builds.tactics: Tara swims to the pilings, climbs onto the quay, and waits out the patrol. If spotted, she Disengages and drops back into the river.

builds.title: Morel Mushroomfolk tunnel guide, Rogue 2
builds.difficulty: Tier 1 class-built NPC · no assigned CR
traits: Proficiency +2. Dexterity save +5 and Intelligence save +2. Leather armor gives AC 11 + Dexterity modifier.
Fungoid Form. Nerin has advantage on saves against poison, resistance to poison damage, and immunity to disease.
Adaptable Camouflage. At least a minute spent adjusting coloration in an area rich in naturally occurring plants or fungi gives Nerin advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks there for 24 hours.

Once per turn, Sneak Attack adds 1d6 to a ranged or finesse weapon hit when Nerin has advantage or another enemy of the target is within 5 ft. of it and isn’t incapacitated. Disadvantage blocks the extra damage unless it is canceled.
Expertise in Stealth and Survival. Proficient with thieves’ tools. Nerin’s background grants Medicine, Nature, Common, and an herbalism kit.
actions: Sling. Ranged weapon attack +5, range 30/120 ft. Hit 1d4 + 3 bludgeoning.
Quarterstaff. Melee weapon attack +1, reach 5 ft. Hit 1d6 − 1 bludgeoning, or 1d8 − 1 with two hands.
Cunning Action. Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a bonus action.
builds.tactics: Nerin adjusts their coloring in a fungus bed before scouting the next tunnel. If a creature follows, they use its route to lead it away from the group.

concepts.name: Vesk Nhal
concepts.motive: Find a route for a missing survey crew to reach its camp before the gates close.
concepts.hook: Vesk has marked a door that disappeared at dusk. He needs someone to hold the last ordinary passage open while he finds it again.

concepts.name: Tara Embercoil
concepts.motive: Rescue a dockhand held on a moored barge.
concepts.hook: Tara can reach the barge from the water if someone draws the sentry away from the mooring.

concepts.name: Nerin Alderfold
concepts.motive: Find a route around a flooded section of tunnel before the overnight market lets out.
concepts.hook: Nerin recognizes fresh morel tracks beyond a blocked side passage. They need help moving a waterlogged beam to follow them.
